blocks.text: Cricket update: 'He's changing the narrative' - Marvellous Mendis stars for Sri Lanka. Kusal Mendis produces a captain's innings at Headingley as he scores 121 off 100 balls to put Sri Lanka on course for a big score as they bat first against England in the second One Day International.
